These six binary fixtures were generated with VYV's reference PSN encoder:
https://github.com/vyv/psn-cpp/tree/master/include

System name: Official VYV encoder. Timestamp: 123456789 microseconds.
150 trackers with IDs 0–149 and names `Tracker N`.
Position: (1.25, -2.5, N). Orientation: (0.1, 0.2, 0.3).
The data frame spans four UDP datagrams; the info frame spans two.
Generated on Linux x86_64 with the upstream C++ encoder (includes its padded
packet header). These fixtures are protocol data, not source code.
